text:
Live Pages. My first published @bot

https://x.ai/bot/ignLvLJlOxOIenZPr-tTA

Live Pages is a Grok Bot that builds (private) interactive web pages and UX on its computer, e.g. tables, forms, checklists, anything really!

You open the page on your phone, desktop, over Tailscale. Until @bot has some native way to privately access its computer, you have to use Tailscale.

Some examples:

- Librarian bot has search filters and a newsfeed UX
- Retirement Planner bot has a data table of my income and expenses

Add Live Pages in Grok Bot if you want to do more than just chat :)
